correctness.rationale: The exact polynomial identity proves H[n,k] >= a^n H[0,k] for every n,k, and strict positivity for n>0 follows from infinitely many positive support points. Positivity of the moments and boundedness of weights are derived. Generalized eigenvalues yield the sharp mass. Uniform Legendre formulas, fixed-X Laplace asymptotics and a uniformly dominated coefficient limit give the Bessel hard-edge formula. Full non-subnormality uses compact moment determinacy. The rational checker verifies sample certificates only, not the infinite assertions.

value.rationale: The family is directly motivated by the explicit non-atomic-charge gap. The theorem compresses infinitely many nontrivial moment positivity tests to one sharp finite certificate; gives every exact k-but-not-(k+1) non-subnormal rung with explicit matrices; and determines a two-regime exponential/Bessel threshold law in the natural support-gap scaling. This has structural and quantitative use beyond textbook kernel identities.
